title: Read what share of a sample falls at or below a value

version: 0.0.1

## Over half of replies arrive within eight minutes

These illustrative reply times show where support answers cluster and how far the slow ones trail. The line steps up at every observed value, from 0 to 100 percent, with nothing smoothed.

```chart
type: ecdf
title: Over half of replies arrive within eight minutes; about one in seven takes longer than twelve
subtitle: Minutes to first reply
data:
  inline:
    - {minutes: 3.1}
    - {minutes: 4.2}
    - {minutes: 4.8}
    - {minutes: 5.0}
    - {minutes: 5.3}
    - {minutes: 5.9}
    - {minutes: 6.1}
    - {minutes: 6.4}
    - {minutes: 6.6}
    - {minutes: 7.0}
    - {minutes: 7.2}
    - {minutes: 7.5}
    - {minutes: 7.9}
    - {minutes: 8.3}
    - {minutes: 8.8}
    - {minutes: 9.4}
    - {minutes: 10.1}
    - {minutes: 10.9}
    - {minutes: 12.0}
    - {minutes: 13.8}
    - {minutes: 15.5}
    - {minutes: 18.9}
encoding: {x: minutes}
axes:
  x: {label: Minutes to first reply}
```

*Source: Illustrative values. The shares are computed from them.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read the share at or below each value.
